notes.content: Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Nutrition and Dietetics is compatible with the B.S. in Nutrition and Food at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better. CHEM 1A, CHEM 1B, and CHEM 20 are recommended for students who plan to complete the Dietetics concentration or graduate studies in nutrition. For additional information, please see the "Nutrition and Food, BS - Dietetics" major. For additional information, please visit: Department of Nutrition and Food .
notes.contentHtml:
1. Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major.
  2. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Nutrition and Dietetics is compatible with the B.S. in Nutrition and Food at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better.
  3. CHEM 1A, CHEM 1B, and CHEM 20 are recommended for students who plan to complete the Dietetics concentration or graduate studies in nutrition. For additional information, please see the "Nutrition and Food, BS - Dietetics" major.
  4. For additional information, please visit: Department of Nutrition and Food.
